description.value: Todai Sushi is a small, 7-table Japanese restaurant in the Delta neighbourhood of the Lower Mainland, offering a broad menu of sushi, rolls, tempura, teriyaki, and noodle dishes rooted in Japanese culinary tradition. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients and a friendly neighbourhood atmosphere, with online ordering available for those who prefer to grab food on the go. A dedicated Vegetarian menu section makes it accessible to a range of dietary needs.
